blocks.text: The unrounded reading equals scale times true value plus bias. Displayed readings are rounded to the nearest whole unit; halfway values round upward. Thus display r means an unrounded reading at least r−0.5 but less than r+0.5. Apart from this rounding, the rules are exact. Values and biases are fictional dimensionless units.
